$comment: Xiaomi MiMo chat models — Token Plan supported. Sources: https://platform.xiaomimimo.com/docs/en-US/quick-start/model (capability matrix) + platform.xiaomimimo.com/docs/zh-CN/price/tokenplan/subscription (Token Plan 8-model list) + live probe (2026-05-27). The 4 chat models below are confirmed callable on Token Plan endpoints. mimo-v2-flash is in the general API catalog but NOT yet on Token Plan (live probe returned 400 `Not supported model mimo-v2-flash`) — removed to avoid false hope. TTS series (4 models) skipped — not chat models, belong in a future audio module. Wire protocol (OpenAI vs Anthropic) is a provider-wide setting (Settings → Xiaomi MiMo → Default protocol), not a per-model variant. Capability matrix: mimo-v2.5-pro = Text + Deep Thinking + Function Call + Web Search. mimo-v2.5 + mimo-v2-omni = also Full-modal Understanding (image/audio/video).
